verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud Agents run in isolated cloud VMs, can build features, start dev servers, click through UI flows to verify changes, and attach screenshots/videos/logs as artifacts to PRs so a reviewer can validate without checking out the branch — directly matching 'build, test, and demo end-to-end for review.' This is backed by first-party docs (capabilities, cloud-agent overview) and a live, key-gated API confirming the platform is real and operational. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the demo-artifact quality and no community corroboration of this specific cloud-agent workflow.
